purpose: Separate the organiser Tier C items used to author the official UB-04 template from the items reserved for one untouched scoring run.
selection_basis: Safe published linkage metadata from eval/official/results/official_sample_rows.jsonl. No page pixels, crops, OCR values, or expected values were read to select the split.
selection_rule: Use the two deterministic items with the highest linkage margin as development; preserve every other deterministic item as holdout.
immutability_note: Items must never move between development and holdout. Any change invalidates later holdout results and requires a new split_id.

development.rationale: Joint-highest deterministic linkage margin in Tier C.
Joint-highest deterministic linkage margin in Tier C.

excluded.reason: Linkage tied with margin 0; excluded from development, holdout, and every accuracy denominator.
